text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read
      discussions: read
    steps:
      - name: Check for @claude mention
        id: check_mention
        run: |
          COMMENT_BODY="${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
          if [[ "$COMMENT_BODY" == *@claude* ]]; then
            echo "triggered=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "triggered=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
      - name: Claude Code Action
        if: |
          (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.comment.author_association != 'NONE') ||
          (github.event_name == 'pull_request_review_comment' && github.event.review.author_association != 'NONE') ||
          (github.event_name == 'issues' && github.event.issue.author_association != 'NONE')
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
```
